headline: Fed to hike at least two times; 10-year Treasury yield highest since 2007
detail: This signals a sustained period of higher interest rates. For your tech/chip heavy, margin-fueled portfolio, this means increased borrowing costs and potentially lower valuations for growth stocks. Your leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) will feel this pain acutely.
rec: Consider trimming positions in QQQ and SMH, which are already on TRIM status, to reduce overall tech exposure. Also, re-evaluate the deep losses in SOXL and SPAL given the amplified risk.

headline: What to expect from stocks and bonds if interest rates remain higher for longer
detail: This reinforces the message of a 'higher for longer' rate environment, which is generally negative for growth stocks and can lead to further pressure on tech valuations. It also increases the cost of holding positions on margin.
rec: Given the sustained pressure, it's prudent to review your most vulnerable positions. Consider cutting losses on SOXL and SPAL to free up capital and reduce margin risk.
